Class AwnserController

java.lang.Object
com.example.eiffelskills_back.controller.AwnserController
@CrossOrigin @RestController @RequestMapping("awnser") public class AwnserController extends Object
AwnserController : Questions are inserted by teachers and managed through this controller. It is also used to check awnsers validity.
